description: Java class 'EntityDataServices' providing entity data import/export, index rebuilding, and encryption-related services for the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityDataServices
classes.description: Provides services for importing, exporting, and managing entity data within OFBiz framework including index rebuilding and encryption management.

methods.name: exportDelimitedToDirectory
methods.description: Stub method for exporting entities to directory, not yet implemented.

methods.name: importDelimitedFromDirectory
methods.description: Imports entity data files from a specified directory, processing each file found.

methods.name: importDelimitedFile
methods.description: Imports a single entity data file into the database, parsing each record.

methods.name: getFileList
methods.description: Retrieves list of data files from directory, either via FILELIST.txt or by directory contents.

methods.name: readEntityHeader
methods.description: Reads the header (field names) from entity data file or its header file.

methods.name: readEntityFile
methods.description: Reads and processes the data file, inserting or updating entity records.

methods.name: makeGenericValue
methods.description: Creates a GenericValue object from a header and line of fields.

methods.name: rebuildAllIndexesAndKeys
methods.description: Rebuilds database indexes, foreign keys, primary keys, and optionally fixes column sizes for specified entity group.

methods.name: unwrapByteWrappers
methods.description: Unwraps byte array wrappers in records for specified entity and field.

methods.name: reencryptPrivateKeys
methods.description: Re-encrypts stored private keys with new encryption key.

methods.name: reencryptFields
methods.description: Re-encrypts encrypted fields for entities in a specified group.
